seal.statement: No read of a status, role, raft_role, workflow_step, phase or step field carries a || or ?? default: each of the 159 sites either reads a value the schema or constructor already guarantees (the services status column is NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active') or routes the absent case to a named state (R07) at the one owner or decoder that defines it; once the count is zero the pattern is an ESLint no-restricted-syntax selector in eslint.config.js and the guideline audit drops it.
